decision.observation: The valid circle-to-square path stays drawn and no feedback appears after the pill or star clicks. Since a left press both submits and starts a new path, the submission may only be reflected in the level-select progress (0.0% boxes).
decision.hypothesis: Exiting to level select will show whether progress changed, revealing whether the submitted solution was accepted.
decision.memory: A left press on the grid submits the active path and starts a new one; no on-screen judgment occurs in-level.
